description: B4e watch wave: one adopted iteration, B4a + b4wave lever tel_codec (--aug_tel_p 0.25 --aug_tel_codecs g723_1 amr_nb), launched by the owner with scripts/run_B4e.sh; baseline B4a (plan the-best-experiment-so-validated-cake.md). Telephony codecs G.711 / G.722 / G.726 are reserved for the local proxy sets and refused at start-up.

trainer.ffmpeg_install_cmd: apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg

lever_queue.hypothesis: B4a never sees narrowband CELP / ADPCM telephony audio, so it reads codec smoothing and the 4 kHz band edge on bona fide speech as synthesis. Training both classes through G.723.1 / AMR-NB on 25% of the codec calls makes those traces class-neutral, and that transfers to the unseen G.722 / G.726 / GSM implementations in sim_heldout_v1.
lever_queue.predicted_signature: vs B4a, same readout: sim_heldout_v1 recall_bona up, driving heldout F1 up; sim_matched_v1 F1 down by at most 0.5 (Opus apps, now 25% fewer Opus clips); dev_online_clean F1 within 0.5; spoof recall within 0.5 on every set; probe sets steady. Caveat: sim_heldout_v1 also has the bandlimit / resample8k stages, so part of a heldout gain can be narrowband familiarity rather than codec transfer; Codabench decides.
lever_queue.falsifier: heldout F1 delta < +0.5 on both readouts while matched F1 drops > 0.5 -> drop the lever.

lever_notes: tel_codec (B4e): codec-slot lever, exclusive with opus_plc; the parent's Opus draws are made either way and the lever draws from its own stream default_rng([seed, pid, 0xB4E]), so the acoustic stages and the WebRTC NS draws are B4a's. Only G.723.1 and AMR-NB are trained on.

adopt.change_vs_ref: + --aug_tel_p 0.25 --aug_tel_codecs g723_1 amr_nb (telephony codecs on 25% of the codec calls)
adopt.rationale: the telephony augmentation from origin/feature/model-updates, restricted to the unreserved codecs
